description: This pie chart visually represents the character distribution within RoleplayPref, which the paper states comprises three primary categories and thirteen subcategories. The chart is structured with a central ring divided into two main sections: a large light blue segment labeled “Virtual Characters” and a smaller green segment labeled “Real Characters.” The “Virtual Characters” category is further subdivided into six distinct slices—“Comic Characters,” “Movie Characters,” “Teleplay Characters,” “Novel Characters,” “Game Characters,” and “Custom Characters”—each rendered in a light blue hue and arranged around the central ring. The “Real Characters” category is subdivided into seven smaller slices—“Scientists,” “Artists,” “Athletes,” “Writers,” “Musicians,” “Actors,” and “Influencers”—each in a light green hue, also arranged around the central ring. The chart includes a legend-like labeling system with text labels positioned directly on or near the corresponding slices, and there are no percentage values or numerical labels shown within the slices. The “Custom Characters” slice is visually distinguished by being slightly offset or exploded from the rest of the “Virtual Characters” ring, while all other slices appear to be standard-sized segments. The overall layout suggests a descending order of size for the subcategories within each primary category, with “Virtual Characters” occupying the largest portion of the chart.
